reporting-org.narrative: The Global Fund to Fight AIDS, Tuberculosis and Malaria

title.narrative: Nepal Round 10 Proposal to Contribute to the Achievement of MDGs, 4,5,6 - Nepal (16-Jul-2016-15-Mar-2018)

description.narrative: Nepal, HIV, Save the Children Federation, Inc. (STC HQ)This program has the following goals: To achieve optimized RRTTR 90-90-90 and combination prevention by 2020. The objectives of this program are: Objective 1: Accelerate and scale up comprehensive package of services for people who inject drugs in selected districts. Objective 2: Expand access to and coverage of quality, equitable and gender-sensitive HIV diagnosis, treatment and care; and STI diagnosis and treatment; through strengthening health and community systems. Objective 3: Scale up PMTCT by integrating and strengthening sexual and reproductive health services
